components.name: @dsh-selfuse/desktop-remote
components.notes: Manager-owned dependency-free relay 0.2.0. Explicit tailnet direct access through private Serve; exact authority, loopback/peer-address/Origin fences and no Funnel. Network-policy-admitted devices gain existing Host privileges. Native signed cookie is obtained/refreshed only in server memory; local Desktop authentication unchanged. Fifteen regressions, native CLI isolation and forty-four live checks pass. Legacy forced DERP debug override removed with protected backup and scoped service recovery; iPad direct latency improved from 467-1671 ms to 3-65 ms. User reports excellent actual results and authorizes publication. Phone, prolonged roaming and fresh model/backup operations remain separate acceptance. No second backend, official ASAR change or WSL service. RustDesk retired with historical scripts archived. Published to origin/main as fd4659bb5d87aaa1526f1d01a43bfe9c726998d4; fetched ref and all thirty-five release blobs match. GitHub reports no workflows or check runs, not passing CI. See docs/desktop-remote-20261003.md and docs/maintenance.md.

Ten packages are installed through the official CLI, external runtime dependencies are routed without copying WSL or ASAR modules, and the exact accepted memory package was updated after normal exit. The new formal Host and Client verification pass; the user confirmed finding the panels. Isolated memory persistence passes; formal saves, real GitHub backup/restore and provider acceptance remain separate. Remote refs must be read back after publication; no passing GitHub CI result is claimed. See scripts/README.md and docs/maintenance.md.
